items.title: Prepare the bench and stock slicer
items.summary: Choose a steady, level spot and get the stock slicer ready. Bookmark the official setup and support pages before unboxing.
items.cost_note: Free preparation; an optional paver is priced separately.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Concrete paver base
items.summary: A heavy base is an inexpensive way to try reducing bench vibration. Calibrate with the printer in its final position.
items.cost_note: Checklist estimate $6–8 for a 16-inch paver; budget uses the $8 upper bound.

source.creator: The Home Depot / Lowe's
source.note: Retailers named in the checklist; no exact paver SKU supplied.

warnings: Check bench load capacity and support the printer securely.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Inspect and assemble on stock firmware
items.summary: Record the serial number, photograph the four toolhead contacts, and check the supplied parts. Follow the official assembly and stock calibration sequence.
items.cost_note: No additional purchase. The checklist reports a spare 0.4 mm stainless hotend in the box; check your packing list before ordering.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Pause and contact official support if any contact, dock, cable, or supplied component looks damaged.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Complete stock burn-in
items.summary: Test each of the four heads separately, then run a four-color job with a prime tower. Save any errors and the idle-noise and temperature baseline before modifying the printer.
items.cost_note: Uses the supplied filament; no extra purchase assumed.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Resolve parking, loading, or calibration failures with support while the machine is still stock.
The time is a planning estimate; model choice changes print duration.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Just-A-Riser XL+
items.summary: Print a vented riser with an optional recessed LED track. Check the creator's fit notes for your intended cover before printing.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.note: Exact model URL retained from checklist; page fetch failed, so the designer handle is pending.

warnings: Re-run vibration compensation after installation.
Cover compatibility is imported from the checklist and has not been physically checked.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: LED strip and USB supply
items.summary: Add lighting to the riser's recessed track using a suitable strip and supply. Match the strip dimensions and voltage to the creator's instructions.
items.cost_note: Checklist estimate $12–18; budget uses $18. Optional lighting, not a prerequisite for the printed riser.

source.note: Checklist names Amazon but no product or manufacturer; exact product and creator pending.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: PTFE fittings, tubing and bearings
items.summary: Gather the small hardware used by selected tube supports and spool holders. Buy to the actual model bill of materials to avoid duplicate parts.
items.cost_note: Checklist estimate ~$35: PC4-M10 fittings, spare PTFE tube, four 608 bearings and zip ties.

source.note: Generic shopping bundle from checklist; no exact SKUs or manufacturers supplied.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: PTFE supports and radius guides
items.summary: Support feed tubes so bends stay gradual and toolhead travel stays clear. Check the whole movement range after fitting clips or adapters.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.note: Exact example from checklist; fetch blocked. Designer handle and separate guide/adapter models need review.

warnings: Some designs need PC4-M10 fittings; check the model's hardware list before printing.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: TPU feed-tube holder
items.summary: A flexible holder can keep feed tubing tidy without a rigid clamp. Select the exact U1 model and confirm clearance before installing it.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.note: Checklist credits Uncle Jessy's mods roundup as discovery only; exact model and original designer were not supplied.

warnings: Original designer link is pending; do not treat the platform homepage as a downloadable model.
Requires suitable TPU filament; filament cost is excluded.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Tool holders and spool adapters
items.summary: Choose holders for the tools you use and adapters that suit your spool dimensions. A bearing-supported holder may help a spool rotate freely.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.note: Checklist names several model types but no individual projects; original designer links pending.

warnings: Bearing-holder designs in the checklist use two 608 bearings per holder; verify your selected model.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Re-run vibration calibration
items.summary: Repeat vibration compensation after changing the base, riser or cover. Save a fresh baseline with the printer in its normal operating position.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: BIQU CryoGrip Pro plate
items.summary: Try a U1-sized textured plate when you want a different PLA or PETG adhesion surface. Let parts cool before removal and follow the plate maker's material guidance.
items.cost_note: Checklist BIQU sale $27.89 (list $39.99); P3D alternative $29. These are 2026-10-26 prices.

source.creator: BIQU
source.note: Checklist sale page; confirm the U1-sized variant before buying.

warnings: A hot or strongly bonded part can damage the surface if forced off.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Paxx12 Extended Firmware
items.summary: Adds community integrations and browser controls to the U1. Read the installation and stock-recovery instructions before changing firmware.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.creator: Paxx12
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Wait until stock burn-in is clean; the checklist schedules installation on Days 4–5.
Damage attributable to custom firmware may not be covered; review the current terms.

provenance.note: Checklist order retained; project documentation reviewed for capabilities and warranty wording. No installed version was tested.

items.title: Enable Spoolman integration
items.summary: Connect supported spool tracking to an existing Spoolman service. Check the project guide for setup and where filament records are stored.
items.cost_note: Integration is free; any separate Spoolman hosting is outside this site's scope.

source.creator: Paxx12; Spoolman contributors
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Integration docs reviewed; no service is hosted by StartHere.

items.title: Enable print notifications
items.summary: Configure completion or failure messages through the extended firmware's notification integration. Choose the external service and events you need.
items.cost_note: No purchase assumed; external service accounts, if chosen, are separate from StartHere.

source.creator: Paxx12
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Set up the WebRTC camera
items.summary: Try the extended firmware's camera view after the printer passes stock tests. A second USB camera is optional.
items.cost_note: Free with the built-in camera; optional USB camera and hub cost extra.

source.creator: Paxx12
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Review Tailscale remote access
items.summary: Use the firmware project's remote-access guide if you want access away from home. Review its external service requirements before enabling it.
items.cost_note: No purchase assumed; external service terms apply. StartHere never connects to your printer.

source.creator: Paxx12
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: OpenSpool NTAG215 tags
items.summary: Use writable spool tags with compatible extended firmware for third-party filament identification. The reader still needs the tag close enough to scan.
items.cost_note: Checklist estimate ~$13 for 10 tags; an NFC-capable writing device is assumed.

source.creator: Paxx12; OpenSpool contributors
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Optional RFID-loss remedy only when a programmed tag can reach the reader; a tag left on a distant dryer spool will not fix detection.

provenance.note: RFID documentation reviewed for firmware support and reader proximity. No physical reading test performed.

items.title: Creality Space Pi X4 dryer
items.summary: A four-spool dryer can prepare and feed several filaments alongside the U1. Plan the tube route and select drying settings for the actual filament.
items.cost_note: Checklist: $159 Creality list, $149 Comgrow, $158.99 recent Amazon, $179 Best Buy. Budget uses manufacturer $159.

source.creator: Creality
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Check supply voltage for your region and use the filament maker's drying limits.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Route dryer feed and set profiles
items.summary: Route PTFE from the dryer to the feeders without tight bends. Select filament profiles manually when remote spools no longer pass the built-in RFID readers.
items.cost_note: Setup adds no new purchase if dryer and suitable tubing are already available; otherwise budget for them separately.

source.creator: Paxx12
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: RFID auto-detection is lost when dryer spools are away from the built-in readers. Set each feeder's filament profile manually.
OpenSpool tags are an optional remedy with extended firmware and deliberate placement near the reader.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Calibrate flow and pressure advance
items.summary: Tune the filaments you actually use and save each result in a named profile. Repeat after changing a hotend or filament when the results no longer fit.
items.cost_note: No purchase; calibration consumes filament.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Test and reduce VFA banding
items.summary: Use a speed test to locate wall banding. The linked community report tries 0.4 mm wall widths, Inner/Outer/Inner order and walls near 210 mm/s; retest within your filament's flow limits.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.creator: tonsofbuns; forum discussion contributors
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: These are starting values from a community report, not a universal U1 profile. Keep volumetric flow within your measured limit.

provenance.note: Original forum discussion reviewed; values retained as a trial, not a guaranteed fix.

items.title: MakerWorld to U1 converter
items.summary: Convert MakerWorld print profiles to U1 projects with Dragon2203's browser extension. Inspect the resulting plate, tool assignments and settings in the slicer before printing.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.creator: Dragon2203
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Checklist did not identify the extension author. Selected Dragon2203's matching project after reviewing its own repository.

items.title: Spare U1 toolhead
items.summary: An optional spare head can reduce downtime while a fault is investigated. Choose the correct slot-specific part rather than assuming all four heads are identical.
items.cost_note: USD price imported from the owner's 2026-10-26 checklist; excludes tax and shipping.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Checklist identifies Toolhead 1 as the left/mirrored version and 2–4 as right-slot versions; confirm the current listing before ordering.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Cleaning, parking and screw spares
items.summary: Keep replacement brushes, parking pads, wipers and screws for routine service. Check which pieces are needed before placing an order.
items.cost_note: Checklist components: brushes/parking pads $3.99 + left wiper $3.99 + right wiper $3.99 + screws $4.99 = $16.96; toolhead is separate.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: The checklist's approximate $78 combined spares total does not equal all listed components; this record uses the explicit line prices.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Official U1 Top Cover
items.summary: The official cover provides an enclosure and an integrated filtration route. Review its circulation modes, firmware requirements and material guidance before an enclosed job.
items.cost_note: Checklist $149 pre-order (list $249); availability and firmware requirement need rechecking.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: A cover or filter does not certify indoor air safety; follow official ventilation and material guidance.
Re-run vibration calibration after fitting.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: DIY IKEA SAMLA lid
items.summary: Use the linked connector project to explore a box-based lid. This route encloses the printer but does not provide the official cover's integrated filtration.
items.cost_note: Checklist $17.99 IKEA box/lid, roughly $18–20; budget uses $20 plus your filament. Other routes mentioned: Coroplast ~$15, IKEALLER ~$55, fully printed ~$60–110.

source.note: Checklist model URL retained; page fetch failed, original designer handle pending.

warnings: No integrated source filtration is assumed; review ventilation before enclosed ABS/ASA printing.
Re-run vibration calibration after fitting.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: BIQU PopCap cover
items.summary: An alternative cover route for owners considering a polycarbonate lid. Check U1 fit, riser compatibility and the vendor's current operating limits.
items.cost_note: Checklist sale $175.99 (list $199.99).

source.creator: BIQU
source.note: Manufacturer homepage; direct U1 PopCap product URL needs confirmation.

warnings: The checklist's 120°C lid rating is not a safe chamber-temperature rating for the U1.
Re-run vibration calibration after fitting.

items.title: Phaetus Liber high-flow hotends
items.summary: A high-flow hotend set targets large parts with long extrusion paths. Check material restrictions and calibrate the matching heads after replacement.
items.cost_note: Checklist $34.99 each or $99 for four (bundle list $119); budget uses the four-pack.

source.creator: Snapmaker / Phaetus
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Checklist and product page advise against TPU, wood and CF/GF in this high-flow route.
Keep all heads used in the job matched; review the current hotend settings guide.

provenance.note: Manufacturer page reviewed for restrictions; checklist prices retained.

items.title: Hardened-steel hotends
items.summary: Choose a wear-resistant hotend for a planned abrasive filament. Confirm material and nozzle compatibility, then tune the affected profile.
items.cost_note: Checklist standard hotend line starts at $15.99 per head; multiple heads cost extra.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

provenance.note: Rewritten from the supplied seed. Imported on 2026-10-28; no printer or firmware test performed.

items.title: Mainboard and PSU cooling review
items.summary: Evaluate a documented fan and duct route for electronics cooling or fan noise. An active-heater setup needs cooling that reaches the main processor, not only the stepper drivers.
items.cost_note: Checklist estimate $20–40 for fans and buck converter; budget uses $40.

source.creator: Paxx12; linked cooling-model designers
source.note: Integration guide links to original cooler models; individual designer credits and PSU wiring design still need review.

warnings: After week one only. Wiring work and machine changes can affect warranty coverage.
Do not open or modify a mains PSU from this summary; use an appropriate complete guide or qualified help.
The processor-cooling requirement is distinct from a stepper-driver temperature reading.

provenance.note: Cooling requirement checked against firmware integration docs; this is a review step, not an installation guide or safety certification.

items.title: BIQU Panda Breath heater/filter
items.summary: Consider an actively heated chamber only after reviewing the U1 integration and thermal risks. Additional motherboard cooling is a prerequisite.
items.cost_note: Checklist US BIQU $87.12; $95.81 with filter pack. Imported prices retained despite a different price shown during source review.

source.creator: BIQU
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: Do not operate without processor/mainboard cooling and a suitable enclosure.
Active chamber heating can cause overheating and damage; follow the U1 integration guide and official support advice.
A product target temperature does not establish a safe operating temperature for the printer.

provenance.note: Manufacturer and U1 integration docs reviewed; seed price retained. Integration source is the cooling item's source.

items.title: Prepare an enclosed ABS/ASA test
items.summary: Review the filament and enclosure instructions before a small ABS or ASA trial. Use a suitable enclosed setup and an appropriate ventilation plan.
items.cost_note: No purchase price; printed parts still consume your filament and power.

source.creator: Snapmaker
source.note: Creator's own page; linked content remains under its original license.

warnings: An enclosure gate expresses a prerequisite, not a health or safety certification.

provenance.note: Added an explicit ABS-dependent setting step so the enclosure gate can be tested without requiring an active heater.
